name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of Mars) — 1 Basic — War Cry

system.description:
The Tremere antitribu focuses their will to fight, hardening their heart against fear and manipulation, though the same discipline locks their warmer feelings away and leaves them cold.

Activate this power with a symbolic gesture or outcry, a howled rebel yell, a muttered chant, a stripe of war paint. For the rest of the scene your Courage is increased by one Trait and you automatically win all ties on Mental Challenges when resisting hostile Discipline effects. So consumed are you with fighting and winning, however, that you gain the Negative Social Trait Tactless for the duration. Retest with Occult.
